paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Yitzchak. He said in Rav’s name (I did not find it). Abba Mar, son of Rav Pappa, betrothed for him (I did not find it and did not understand; see Rav Pappa). He said in Rav Chisda’s name, end of Menachot, 110a. Rabbi Ze'ira indicated to Rabbi Ba bar Yitzchak (Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, chapter 2).
